definitions.explanation: The completion of a course of study at a school or university; also used metaphorically for moving on from something.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}{大学|だいがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}します。
examples.english: I will graduate from university next year.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}は{三月|さんがつ}です。
examples.english: The graduation ceremony is in March.

examples.japanese: そのアイドルグループを{卒業|そつぎょう}しました。
examples.english: She graduated from that idol group.

notes:
{卒業|そつぎょう} marks completing an educational program. The opposite is {入学|にゅうがく} (enrollment).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{卒業|そつぎょう}する: to graduate from ~
- {卒業|そつぎょう}{式|しき}: graduation ceremony
- {卒業|そつぎょう}{生|せい}: graduate, alumnus
- {卒業|そつぎょう}{論文|ろんぶん}: graduation thesis

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, the school year ends in March, so graduation ceremonies are typically held in March. Cherry blossoms are a symbol of both graduation and new beginnings.
